mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points from the prior month signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) by at least 1% from the prior month indicate a contracting housing sector that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST decline by ≥1% from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply chain disruption indicated by industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 for two consecutive months reduces corporate output and increases inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 jobs signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS declines by >100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer spending and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A three-month consecutive decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing sector weakness that reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 for three consecutive months.
